errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the countries on the x-axis are in a random order. In fact, they are sorted in ascending order based on the total height of the bars (total energy cost).
The color for the 'Твърди горива' (Solid fuels) category is purple, not dark blue ('тъмносиньо').
The color for the 'Електроенергия' (Electricity) category is teal/light blue, not 'dark blue-blue' ('тъмносиньо-синьо'). This description is confusing and inaccurate.
The bar for Latvia (LV) reaches the 250 € mark, not 'under 200 €'.

errors.text_span: Най-висок относителен дял на енергията в общите разходи се отбелязва в Италия (IT) – около 22%
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly identifies Italy (IT) as having the highest relative share at 22%. According to the chart, the diamond marker for IT is at approximately 16%. The highest shares are for Malta (MT, ~21%) and Romania (RO, ~19.5%), excluding the outlier point above France (FR).
The description incorrectly identifies Denmark (DK) as having the lowest relative share. While DK's share is low (around 10%), Luxembourg (LU) has a visibly lower share, at approximately 4%.

errors.text_span: в други, като Полша (PL) и Унгария (HU), по-голям дял имат твърдите горива и природният газ
errors.evidence: This statement is incorrect for Poland (PL). For PL, the largest component of energy costs is 'Твърди горива' (solid fuels, purple), but 'Природен газ' (natural gas, red) is a very small component. The main components are solid fuels and electricity.
